newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX FALLS 0.085PTS TO 103.198.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX FALLS 0.085PTS TO 103.198.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.085 points in Tuesday's trading to 103.198, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.768 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.110 points to 100.827, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.309 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 5.939 points to 1,028.358.
